data.name: Rishabhav
data.gender_notes: Rishabhav is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rishabhav is a Hindu name, derived from Sanskrit, referring to Lord Krishna's first incarnation as a bull, symbolizing strength and divine guidance. The name Rishabhav carries the meaning “Lord of the Beasts” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Rishabhav usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the beasts and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine strength and leadership, guiding humanity towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Rishabhav belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Beasts.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rishabhav total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rishabhav carries a deep cultural significance, as it is associated with Lord Vishnu's first avatar in the form of a bull, Rishabh. This symbolizes Lord Vishnu's great strength and his role as a provider of guidance and prosperity. The bull is also considered auspicious in Hindu mythology and is often seen in various temple carvings, artwork, and religious celebrations.
data.spiritual_significance: The Sanskrit name 'Rishabhav' holds immense spiritual significance, as it is rooted in India's ancient religious traditions. The name embodies the power and wisdom of Lord Vishnu, who is believed to be the supreme creator and preserver of the universe. By using this name, one can invoke the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu for strength, wisdom, and spiritual growth. Additionally, the name Rishabhav signifies the ultimate truth that behind every form of god exists the all-pervading consciousness of the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rishabh signifies the first seed of creation, the first cosmic teacher who initiated the cycle of life and cosmos through his austere penance and self-sacrifice. It represents the primal force of the universe, the embodiment of dharma and righteousness.

vedic_reference.note: Not found in Vedas or Upanishads.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rishabhav is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a sage. The name Rishabhav carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rishabhav is associated with the creation of the universe.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rishabhav remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
